=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:3096 and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18655 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The reviewer reads the `case` marker sanity-check patterns (`"<!-- ai:heal-test-only-approval:v1 issue=${ISSUE_NUMBER} plan_comment="*" -->"` and the matching `${issue_num}` pattern) as treating `*` as a literal asterisk. On that reading a real marker from `heal_test_only_marker()` (scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py lines 1246-1248), which includes `plan_comment=<id> paths=<list>`, can never match.
  WHY: If so, every approve decision falls to the `*)` branch and is reset to hold with reason `heal_test_only_check_unavailable` (plan.yml:3097-3098; orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18656-18658). The #8809 auto-approval would then never fire in plan.yml or the poller, and the reviewer says `test_plan_step_approves_a_test_only_unverified_plan` and `test_poller_test_only_check_behaviour` must fail. Reported as BLOCKER.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:1233-1481 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The test-only weakening check can be bypassed in two ways. `_HEAL_COLLECTION_HOOKS` (line 1411, used at line 1461) counts only `pytest_collection_modifyitems` and `pytest_ignore_collect`, so other hooks in tests/conftest.py go undetected, such as a `pytest_runtest_makereport` hook that sets `rep.outcome = "passed"`, or `pytest_runtest_call`, `pytest_configure` or `pytest_pyfunc_call`. Separately, the non-.py skip at line 1480 makes tests/pytest.ini, .pytest.ini, tox.ini and setup.cfg invisible to the check, even though they match `_HEAL_TEST_ONLY_PATH_RE` (line 1233).
  WHY: A test-only plan that lists these paths is auto-approved and locked, and `run_heal_test_only_weakening_check` returns allow. heal_isolated_implement.sh then transfers an edit that makes the failing check pass or deselects it (for example with `addopts = --deselect ...` or `-k "not flaky"`), with no human review. All reviewers rated it MAJOR. gemini cited lines 1373-1430/1480.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:1491 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `if after["skips"] > before["skips"]:` compares one total for the whole file. An edit that moves an existing skip marker onto the flaky test passes, and so does one that flips `skipif(False, ...)` to `skipif(True, ...)`.
  WHY: In any test file that already has a skip (the fixture `_TO_BASE_TEST` has one on `test_b`), the flaky test can be skipped and the edit is still allowed and transferred. Reported as NIT.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:1445-1480 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: In `run_heal_test_only_weakening_check`, paths are not fully sanitized against directory traversal before they reach OS-level read functions.
  WHY: An attacker who controls base_dir or edited_dir could read files outside the expected directories, despite the lstat symlink checks. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5's verification notes reject this: locked paths pass `heal_test_only_path_ok` and `_plan_grant_path(path) == path`, and base_dir and edited_dir are set by the script.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18518-18666 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `HEAL_TEST_ONLY_GATE_DECISION` and `HEAL_TEST_ONLY_GATE_REASON` (lines 18518-18519, 18621-18622, 18665-18666) are assigned but never read in production code, and there is no `# shellcheck disable=SC2034` directive.
  WHY: The reviewers say ShellCheck SC2034 fails the ci.yml shellcheck job and blocks merge. Both rated it MAJOR. gemini also listed `HEAL_TEST_ONLY_GATE_MARKER`, which minimax says is read by `_plan_auto_approval_gate`. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash reject this: SC2034 is a warning, and ci.yml:455 and prepush_affected_tests.py:121 both run `--severity=error`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18600-18670 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In `_plan_heal_test_only_check`, the `scope_file` created by `mktemp` (gemini cited line 18645) is removed only on a normal exit. It is not removed on interruption (SIGTERM/SIGINT).
  WHY: Interrupted poller runs leave `heal_test_only_scope.XXXXXX` files in RUNTIME_DIR or /tmp, causing slow inode growth. Both rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejects this because there is no early return between creating the file and `rm -f`.
- scripts/implement_heal_preflight.sh:166-167 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: HEAL_TEST_ONLY_LOCK_FILE is exported through GITHUB_ENV as an implicit, non-standard dependency for later steps.
  WHY: Downstream steps may fail or misbehave if the variable is empty, points to a missing file, or is misused. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejects this: heal_isolated_implement.sh refuses a lock file that is set but missing or a symlink (line 357), and non-heal steps are gated on `HEAL_ROUTE != 'true'`.
- scripts/implement_heal_preflight.sh:131-172 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `--heal-test-only-lock-scope` decision runs the guard copy relative to the working directory (`scope_guard_py="${FILES_TOUCHED_SCOPE_GUARD_PY:-scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py}"`). It runs before the immutable support or trusted-root checkout is set up, and implement.yml does not export `FILES_TOUCHED_SCOPE_GUARD_PY`.
  WHY: The lock may be decided by a guard copy that the same job has just written. There is no in-PR attack path today, but the trust is implicit by default for future changes. Reported as NIT.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:3283-3297 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `ai:heal-test-only-approval:v1` marker POST has no check for an existing marker. The poller's matching block (`gate_replan_jq` `select(contains($marker))`, scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18893-18902) does have one.
  WHY: A re-run, or a retry after a failed `/approved` POST, posts a duplicate marker comment. This is harmless for the lock, which reads the newest marker, but it clutters the issue. Both rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejects this because each run posts a new plan comment, so the `plan_comment` value differs.
- tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py:1644-1857 and tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:10570, 12105 | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate classifies the new test_files_touched_scope_guard.py block and `test_complete_verdict_falls_through_to_finalize_on_integration_drift` / `test_sync_superseded_sets_state_once_and_skips_future_sync_attempts` as failures caused by this change. Check-run collection timed out with no logs, and static review finds no defect.
  WHY: The cause is unknown without re-running the suite (real defect, stale fixture, or a misclassified inherited failure), and the gate cannot be cleared until then. Reported as MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, scripts/implement_heal_preflight.sh, scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh (pre-push gate output) | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate lists 11 failures as caused by this change, including files the diff does not touch (test_gh_api_write_guard, test_no_session_automation, test_operator_step_issue, test_pr_merge_status_guard, test_ai_labels*). Collection_status was timeout, and test_plan_heal_counterfactual_gate.py is missing from the list even though the case-pattern defect implies it must fail.
  WHY: The merge gate's accounting cannot be trusted, and merging would ship the broken marker pattern unverified. Reported as MAJOR.

- requirement: "The orchestrator's poll recovery also uses the same check." (the marker must be checked for freshness against last_edited_at)
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (_plan_auto_approval_gate)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: `_plan_heal_test_only_check` is implemented, but `_plan_auto_approval_gate` does not check the test-only approval marker against `last_edited_at` from the issue details map. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash reject this gap: `_plan_heal_test_only_check` requires `has("last_edited_at")` (orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18641-18645), and `_fetch_candidate_issue_details_graphql` selects `lastEditedAt`.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:1233, 1411, 1461, 1480 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test-only lock can be bypassed. Route 1 is a new tests/pytest.ini: it matches `_HEAL_TEST_ONLY_PATH_RE` and is skipped at line 1480, and pytest picks it up for test paths under tests/ (`addopts = --deselect ...` or `-k "not flaky"`). Route 2 is a pytest hook in tests/conftest.py other than the two in `_HEAL_COLLECTION_HOOKS`, such as a `pytest_runtest_makereport` hookwrapper that sets `rep.outcome = "passed"`, or `pytest_runtest_call` / `pytest_configure`.
  WHY: The plan is auto-approved, heal_isolated_implement.sh lines 356-363 return allow, and the failing check passes or never runs. Proposed fix: refuse basenames pytest.ini, .pytest.ini, tox.ini, setup.cfg and pyproject.toml, count every new top-level `pytest_*` function, and add refuse cases to tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:1491 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `if after["skips"] > before["skips"]:` counts skips for the whole file, so moving an existing skip onto another test, or flipping `skipif(False, ...)` to `skipif(True, ...)`, passes.
  WHY: The flaky test can be skipped in any file that already has a skip (as `_TO_BASE_TEST` does on `test_b`). Proposed fix: count skips per test function.
- Verification notes, which the reviewer says are not findings (8 related items). The reviewer rejects these claims: the SC2034 CI failure (ci.yml lines 454-455 run `--severity=error`), the duplicate plan.yml marker (plan.yml line 2750 posts a new comment each run), the `mktemp` leak, path traversal in `run_heal_test_only_weakening_check`, plan.yml variable pollution (plan.yml line 3155), the `GITHUB_ENV` export (heal_isolated_implement.sh line 357), and the poller `last_edited_at` gap. The pre-push failure of test_files_touched_scope_guard.py could not be reproduced. The copilot check failure was `custom_instructions_too_large`, which is unrelated to the diff.
- HARDENING (2 related items):
  - Near line 1480, refuse locked tests/ config basenames (including conftest.py) unless the edited copy is byte-identical to the base (about 4 lines).
  - At line 1461, count every `pytest_*` function and `pytest_plugins` assignment (about 2 lines).
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
